subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and under what default or opt-in policy?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the desired fix changes what unmentioned group media is retained and exposed to later agent turns, which is a privacy/security boundary rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Explicit opt-in replay
options.body: Allow history-media replay only for groups/topics that opt into a named trusted mode, with bounded storage and cleanup proof.

options.title: Default bounded replay
options.body: Treat media as part of normal group history by default and rely on existing allowlists/context visibility plus retention limits.

options.title: Keep current skip behavior
options.body: Do not retain unmentioned media; document that users must use ambient/always-on or mention the bot when media should be processed.

recommendation.title: Explicit opt-in replay
recommendation.body: Allow history-media replay only for groups/topics that opt into a named trusted mode, with bounded storage and cleanup proof.
